key_findings: Amine-functionalized C80 metallofullerenes scavenge radicals, reduce LPS-induced inflammatory genes (tnf-α, il-1, cox-2) and p38/p65 signaling in macrophages
They alleviate mechanical hyperalgesia in a mouse lumbar radiculopathy model and TNF-α-induced IL-6/cox-2 in DRG explants
